## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the implementation plan and PRD requirements where useful.

## Verification

List actual checks and results. Identify physical-device scenarios or external-service steps that remain unverified.

## Data and operations

Describe migrations, target environment aliases, new configuration, compatibility, and recovery if applicable. Do not include secrets or patient data.

## Continuity

Update current state, active plan, work log, and tools/decisions as appropriate.
